notes: Cash-basis nonprofit visitors bureau; statements present two governmental funds (Visitor Promotion, Visitor Improvement), Total column used. Interest 15,846 is printed under Other Financing Sources (p4) below the printed Total receipts 1,290,142, so recorded as a receipt with outside_printed_total. Transfers between the two funds (9,844) net to zero in the Total column; transfers_in/out left null. Function for spending is not printed (only objects), so all treated as economic development (tourism) with capital outlay separate. The budget schedule (p9, unaudited) covers all funds combined and is recorded in detail; its receipts total 1,305,988 includes interest. Prior-year (2024) pages 5-6 and 8 not used. Cash includes certificates of deposit in 2024 only; no investments at 6/30/2025. No liabilities on the cash-basis net position statement. Read pages 1-9 of 9
